# Trevyk Technologies

> Trevyk Technologies builds technology around your businesssoftware, websites, AI, and digital growth. HQ Noida, India; clients across India and remotely worldwide. Flagship product: Kiduart School ERP (kiduart.com). Reply within one business day: contact@trevyk.com

Trevyk is the technology and growth practice. Kiduart is the school ERP product brand. Lead with the client’s business problemnot an industry laundry list or a service shopping list. Do not invent client counts, rankings, profit guarantees, foreign offices, or live AI features that are not described as shipped.
